# 100万粉丝后，他悟了：个人品牌才是最好的护城河



你有没有算过——

要发多少条内容，才能涨到100万粉丝？

Kushank Aggarwal算了：

4年。

每天发。

从2020年到2024年。

从0到100万+。

他不是网红脸。

不是跳舞唱歌的。

是个做AI工具的程序员。

**【从Arduino到Product Manager】**

Kushank大学学的是计算机系统工程。

那时候迷上了Arduino。

做各种小 gadget。

但他意识到——

硬件很难当饭吃。

毕业后去了咨询公司。

 healthcare领域。

无聊得要死。

后来转去做产品经理。

好一些，但还是不够。

他想建自己的东西。

**【边上班边做内容】**

2020-2022年，

他白天上班，

晚上做内容。

为什么？

"为了走出舒适区。"

就这么简单。

结果——

4年后，100万+粉丝。

 across all platforms。

2022年底，

他带着内容创作剩下的钱，

加上工作积蓄，

辞职了。

拉上了兄弟和一个朋友。

全职搞创业。

**【三个产品，月入3-3.5万】**

他现在做三个产品：

**Prompt-Genie**

AI提示词生成工具。

刚上线的时候，

靠他的TikTok病毒视频，

做到月入1万美元。

后来掉到4000。

**Map-This**

AI思维导图。

月入8000。

**Looplytic**

AI用户访谈工具。

刚发布MVP。

还有一些早期客户。

三个加起来，

产品收入大概占一半。

另一半来自——

内容创作。

品牌合作。

赞助帖子。

总共月入3-3.5万美元。

**【Prompt-Genie的起起伏伏】**

Prompt-Genie的想法哪来的？

Kushank发现TikTok上很多病毒传播的提示词，

质量很差。

明显有需求，

但供给质量不行。

他说：我能做得更好。

四天做了个简单版本。

核心概念有了就行，

不求完美。

一开始用的是no-code工具。

后来才换成React+Node+AWS。

一上线就收费。

测试用户愿不愿意付费。

这很重要。

TikTok病毒视频带来第一批流量。

月入1万美元。

但——

他后来犯了个错。

**【三个月的欧洲旅行，代价是什么？】**

产品刚有起色，

Kushank去欧洲玩了三个月。

没怎么管Prompt-Genie。

回来后——

流量掉了。

收入掉了。

他又开始做Chrome扩展版本，

但精力分散了。

这是个经典错误。

创业者总以为自己能 multitask。

其实不能。

2023年11月，

他一个关于自定义GPT工作流的视频爆了。

意识到：这里有需求，可以做App。

14天 pivoted。

做了新东西。

整个2024年都在完善。

**【定价的实验】**

Prompt-Genie的定价变了好几次。

一开始3天免费试用，

然后3.99美元。

五个月后改成5.99美元，

转化率没变，

但流失还是高。

2024年，

改成免费试用不需要信用卡，

然后9美元月费。

流失下来了。

Map-This一开始5.99美元，

但PDF上传免费。

发现很多人光传PDF不付钱，

亏大了。

赶紧锁上这个功能，

放到付费计划里。

管用。

但11月涨到9.99美元，

转化率崩了。

用户 price sensitive（价格敏感）。

降回5.99美元。

Kushank说：还在优化Looplytic的定价。

**【增长主要靠内容】**

大部分用户增长来自——

他自己的社交媒体账号。

TikTok实验。

内容营销。

还有12周的email course。

 subtle 地推产品。

最近试了AI生成内容（AIGC）。

用AI生成的avatar做hook，

然后接产品demo视频。

Prompt-Genie的账号从300粉涨到1万。

每天100多个点击从Instagram bio来。

SEO也在做。

Map-This针对"mind maps"等关键词，

多语言版本。

流量不大，

但是个有趣的实验。

**【他的核心洞察：找你的杠杆】**

Kushank说：

Find and use your leverage。

你的杠杆可以是——

个人品牌。

人脉。

洞察。

速度。

细分技能。

他说：先做个人品牌，再做产品。

建产品越来越容易了。

如果你从零开始，

先在你想解决问题的领域建立品牌。

而且——

个人品牌没有捷径。

就是做自己。

这是AI暂时copy不了的。

他说：我从没想过会成为creator。

但这是发生在我身上最好的事。

现在我们的杠杆就是内容。

如果 launch 产品，

可以0营销预算拿到几百个用户。

**【如果能重来】**

Kushank说他会做几件事不同：

1. 更相信产品，保持Prompt-Genie launch后的势头。

2. 只专注用户最在乎的功能，不堆功能。

3. 早点想清楚定价模式。

4. 更多对齐产品和核心营销渠道（内容营销）。

**【终极目标是自由】**

他说：我在优化生活，为了自由。

做我想做的事，不是必须做的事。

有个收入目标——

七位数年收入。

不是什么 crazy 的数字。

然后就"退出金钱游戏"。

短期目标——

consolidate（整合）。

内容方面——

尽可能多实验AI，

分享结果和 top findings。

让用户不用自己踩坑。

商业方面——

consolidate，优化收入。

专注表现好的产品，

其他的 autopilot。

然后——

一旦收入够，

招 inspiring 的人，

建更多产品，

像venture studio那样运作。

最大的障碍是什么？

Shiny object syndrome（ shiny 物体综合征）。

这个领域变化太快。

太多想法，

太多机会。

需要精准选择。

**【你的杠杆是什么？】**

Kushank的故事告诉我们——

在AI时代，

技术门槛越来越低。

每个人都是潜在客户。

但这也意味着——

竞争越来越激烈。

你怎么脱颖而出？

Kushank的答案是：

个人品牌。

100万粉丝，

不只是虚荣指标。

是 Distribution（分发能力）。

是信任。

是 launch 任何产品时，

那第一批几百个用户。

你呢？

你的杠杆是什么？

如果没有——

今天就开始建。

写第一条tweet。

发第一个视频。

分享你的学习过程。

不要等到"准备好了"。

Kushank也没准备好。

他只是开始了。

*P.S. 想看Kushank的AI工具？

去搜Prompt-Genie、Map-This、Looplytic。

或者关注他的TikTok——

看看100万粉丝的creator是怎么讲故事的。*

**

content_en:
After 1 million fans, he realized that personal brands are the best moat

Have you ever calculated--

How many pieces of content does it take to post to reach 1 million fans?

Kushank Aggarwal Forget it:

4 years.

Send it every day.

From 2020 to 2024.

From 0 to 1 million +.

He is not an Internet celebrity.

Not dancing and singing.

He is a programmer who makes AI tools.

[From Arduino to Product Manager]

Kushank University studied computer systems engineering.

I was fascinated by Arduino.

Make all kinds of little gadgets.

But he realized--

Hardware is hard to eat.

After graduation, I went to a consulting company.

 Healthcare field.

It's boring to death.

Later, he transferred to work as a product manager.

Better, but still not enough.

He wants to build his own thing.

[Doing content while working]

2020-2022 Year,

He works during the day,

Do content at night.

Why?

"To get out of your comfort zone. "

It's that simple.

The result--

Four years later, 1 million + fans.

 across all platforms。

By the end of 2022,

He took the rest of the money from content creation and

Add to your work savings,

Resigned.

Got a brother and a friend.

Start a business full time.

[Three products, monthly income of 30,000 - 35,000 yuan]

He now makes three products:

Prompt-Genie

AI prompt word generation tool.

When we first went online,

With his TikTok virus video,

Make a monthly income of US$10,000.

Later it fell to 4000.

Map-This

AI Mind Map.

Monthly income is 8000.

Looplytic

AI user interview tool.

MVP was just released.

There are also some early customers.

Add up the three,

Product revenue accounts for about half.

The other half comes from--

Content creation.

Brand cooperation.

Sponsored posts.

The total monthly income is US$30,000 - 35,000.

[The ups and downs of Prompt-Genie]

Where did Prompt-Genie get the idea?

Kushank found many tips on TikTok about virus spread.

The quality is poor.

There is obvious demand,

But the quality of supply is not good.

He said: I can do better.

A simple version was made in four days.

As long as you have the core concept,

Don't seek perfection.

At the beginning, I used the no-code tool.

Later, it was switched to React+Node+AWS.

Charge as soon as you go online.

Test whether users are willing to pay.

This is important.

TikTok virus video brought the first batch of traffic.

Monthly income is US$10,000.

But--

He later made a mistake.

[What is the cost of a three-month trip to Europe?]

The product has just improved,

Kushank went to Europe for three months.

I didn't care much about Prompt Genie.

After coming back--

Traffic dropped.

Income is lost.

He started making extended versions of Chrome again,

But my energy was scattered.

This is a classic mistake.

Entrepreneurs always think they can multiask.

Actually I can't.

In November 2023,

One of his videos about customizing GPT workflows exploded.

Realize that there is a need here and you can make apps.

14 days pivoted.

Made something new.

It is improving throughout 2024.

[Experiment in Pricing]

Prompt-Genie's pricing has changed several times.

Start with a free 3-day trial,

Then $3.99.

Change it to 9 five months later,

The conversion rate has not changed,

But the loss is still high.

In 4,

Change to a free trial without requiring a credit card,

Then the monthly fee is $9.

It's lost.

Map-This starts at 9 and

But PDF uploads are free.

Found that many people just transfer PDFs without paying,

I lost a lot.

Lock this function quickly and

Put it in a paid plan.

It works.

But it rose to 9 in November,

The conversion rate collapsed.

Users are price sensitive.

Down to $5.99.

Kushank said: We are still optimizing Loopytic's pricing.

[Growth mainly depends on content]

Most user growth comes from--

His own social media account.

TikTok experiment.

Content marketing.

There is also a 12-week email course.

 Subtle promotes products.

Recently I tried AI-generated content (AIGC).

Use AI-generated avatar to make hooks,

Then receive the product demo video.

Prompt-Genie's account has grown from 300 fans to 10,000.

More than 100 clicks a day come in from Instagram bio.

SEO is also doing it.

Map-This targets keywords such as "mind maps" and

Multi-language version.

Traffic is not large,

But an interesting experiment.

[His core insight: Find your leverage]

Kushank said:

Find and use your leverage。

Your leverage can be--

Personal brand.

connections.

insight.

Speed.

Break down skills.

He said: Make a personal brand first, then make a product.

Building products is getting easier and easier.

If you start from scratch,

Build your brand first in the area you want to solve the problem.

And--

There are no shortcuts to personal brands.

is to be yourself.

This is something AI cannot copy temporarily.

He said: I never thought I would become a creator.

But it was the best thing that ever happened to me.

Now our leverage is content.

If launch products,

You can get hundreds of users with zero marketing budget.

[If I could start over]

Kushank said he would do a few things differently:

1. Trust more in the product and maintain the momentum after the Prompt-Genie launch.

2. Focus only on the functions that users care about most, and don't stack functions.

3. Think about the pricing model early.

4. More align products and core marketing channels (content marketing).

[The ultimate goal is freedom]

He said: I am optimizing my life for freedom.

Doing what I want to do is not something I have to do.

There is an income goal--

Seven-figure annual income.

Not crazy numbers.

Then "quit the money game."

Short-term goals--

consolidate.

Content aspect--

Experiment with AI as much as possible,

Share results and top findings.

Let users not have to step in the trap themselves.

Commercial aspects--

Consolidate to optimize revenue.

Focus on products that perform well,

Other autopilot.

And then--

Once you earn enough,

Recruiting people,

Build more products,

Works like venture studio.

What are the biggest obstacles?

Shiny object syndrome.

This area is changing too fast.

Too many ideas,

Too many opportunities.

Precise choices are needed.

[What is your leverage?]

Kushank's story tells us--

In the AI era,

The technical threshold is getting lower and lower.

Everyone is a potential customer.

But it also means--

Competition is becoming increasingly fierce.

How do you stand out?

Kushank's answer is:

Personal brand.

1 million fans,

Not just vanity indicators.

It is Distribution.

It's trust.

When launching any product,

The first batch of hundreds of users.

What about you?

What is your leverage?

If not--

Start building today.

Write the first tweet.

Send the first video.

Share your learning process.

Don't wait until you're "ready."

Kushank was not ready either.

He just started.

*P.S. Want to see Kushank's AI tools?

Search Prompt-Genie, Map-This, Looplytic.

Or follow his TikTok--

See how creator with 1 million fans tells the story. *

**
